items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Milt Gabler had him on Commodore, because I know he was on Billie’s records

ctx.x: Right. There’s like nothing. How could it be, when all these second- and third-rate musicians were making all kinds of records, that Frankie Newton does not wind up in the studio once?
Milt Gabler had him on Commodore, because I know he was on Billie’s records, some of Billie’s records.
Just in ’39. Just those first records.
